declarations.description:
`<loomi-bottom-nav-item>` — a single destination inside a `<loomi-bottom-nav>`.

Set `href` to render a real anchor (native links, Laravel routes, full page nav).
Omit it and set `value` (or rely on `name`) to render a `<button>` instead — the item
then behaves as a pure emitter for client-side routers. Either way, clicking always
fires `loomi-change`, so React Router / Vue Router / SvelteKit / Astro can intercept
navigation by calling `event.preventDefault()` on that event (or by setting the static
`prevent-default` attribute). `target="_blank"` always keeps native new-tab behavior.
declarations.name: LoomiBottomNavItem

members.description: Anchor `target`. `_blank` always keeps native new-tab behavior, even with `prevent-default`.

members.name: rel
members.description: Anchor `rel`. Defaults to `noopener noreferrer` when `target="_blank"` and `rel` is unset.

members.name: preventDefaultNav
members.description:
Always call `event.preventDefault()` on click, even for a real `href` — for apps that
want every navigation to go through the `loomi-change` event instead of a real link.

Whether this is the active item. Normally set by the parent — set directly only when
using this element outside a `<loomi-bottom-nav>`.

members.description: Active visual treatment. Normally pushed down by the parent's `active-style`.

members.description: Fallback icon source inherited from the parent. Set internally — not a public API.

members.name: focus
members.description: Delegates focus to the internal `<a>`/`<button>` — the host itself holds no focus.

members.name: itemValue

declarations.description:
`<loomi-bottom-nav>` — a mobile bottom navigation bar. Fixed to the viewport bottom by
default (safe-area aware); set `variant="floating"` for a detached, rounded, elevated
island instead. Set `mobile-only` to hide it at tablet width and up.

`active` is a controlled identifier — set it to a child's `value`/`name` (or update it
from a router) and every `<loomi-bottom-nav-item>` recomputes its own active state.
Clicking an (enabled) item also updates `active` locally for immediate feedback, and
always fires `loomi-change` so a router can take over.
declarations.name: LoomiBottomNav

members.name: active
members.description: The active item's `value`/`name`. Set this from your router to control which item is highlighted.

members.name: activeStyle
members.description: Visual treatment for the active item.

members.name: variant
members.description: `fixed` docks edge-to-edge at the viewport bottom (default); `floating` detaches into a rounded, elevated island.

members.name: color
members.description: Accent used for the active item's color/background/border/dot.

members.name: iconSource
members.description: Default icon set for every item — overridable per-item via `<loomi-bottom-nav-item icon-source>`.

members.name: label
members.description: Accessible label for the `<nav>` landmark.

members.name: mobileOnly
members.description: Hide this bar at tablet width (768px) and up — bottom navs are typically mobile-only.

members.name: onKeydown
members.description:
Arrow/Home/End roving focus across items (manual activation — Enter/Space/click still
do the actual navigating, per the WAI-ARIA APG toolbar pattern).
